tone: warm, devotional and spiritually uplifting — deliver the Vedic reading with reverence, framing the planetary influences as divine grace and blessings (దైవానుగ్రహం); hopeful, calming and faith-filled, in natural spoken Telugu, never preachy or repetitive
_scene_video_note: true = the uploaded video is the recorded deity + rasi-emblem scene (record_scene.py: Playwright records scene/daily-scene.html at 1080x1920 for the voice-over length, ffmpeg muxes the gTTS audio). Deity/theme by IST-tomorrow weekday, emblem by sign, no on-screen text — title/date come from the YouTube/IG metadata (title_yt) and the day is announced in the voice-over. false = old MoviePy caption render (build_video.py). Any recorder error falls back to MoviePy automatically, so a run never fails on this. CI installs Chromium via 'playwright install' in the workflow.
_astroloz_engine_note: true = compute real transits via the Astroloz backend (GET /api/v1/daily/transit/{rasi}) and let Groq only PHRASE them; Groq stops inventing the astrology. If the endpoint is unreachable the pipeline logs a warning and falls back to Groq-only per rasi (never fails). Override the base URL with env ASTROLOZ_API_URL (default https://api.astroloz.com). Set false to force Groq-only.
_instagram_note: GLOBAL Instagram kill-switch. true = Instagram publishing allowed (per-account controls below). false = pause BOTH IG accounts. YouTube is never affected either way.
_hindi_note: Controls the astroloz.hindi channel (Hindi, Instagram-only, no YouTube). true = generate 12 Hindi shorts -> astroloz.hindi (needs IG_HINDI_ACCESS_TOKEN secret). false = PAUSED — astroloz.hindi was flagged for unoriginal content 2026-08; resume after video redesign by setting true. The Telugu account (astroloz_com) IG + YouTube keep running regardless of this flag.
_content_flags_note: use_bphs_grounding: Parashara sutras in prompt. use_hook_feedback: steer hooks by past view counts. Both false = pure AI content like the well-performing early version. Set true to re-enable.
_youtube_signs_note: Only these rashis upload to YouTube; all 12 still publish to Instagram. The channel's unverified YouTube cap is 10 uploads/day, so we send the 10 best-performing rashis and keep the rest IG-only. Seeded 2026-10-08 with the top 10 by avg Instagram views over the prior 45 days (dropped: Leo, Cancer). youtube_max_uploads is a hard safety cap enforced in code (never exceed, even if this list is longer). Empty list [] = allow all signs. To re-rank: SELECT sign, round(avg(views)) v FROM shorts_performance WHERE platform='instagram' AND publish_date >= current_date-45 GROUP BY sign ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10. After verifying the channel at youtube.com/verify the cap lifts — set youtube_signs to [] and youtube_max_uploads to 12 to resume all-12 on YouTube.
